name: Agent Flywheel
description: Agent Flywheel for JavaScript and TypeScript agents: capture the turns your agent serves, run the graded training rollouts your control plane sends, and apply the system prompt and model a person approved. Works with any framework (Vercel AI SDK, LangChain.js, LangGraph.js, Mastra, the OpenAI SDK or plain code) through one import, and loads as a plugin into OpenClaw and DeepSeek Harness. Never alters a tool result. Zero runtime dependencies.

apiKey.description: PerceptEye flywheel key (pefw_...). Without it the plugin records locally and contacts nothing.

agentId.description: The agent name this install reports as. Unset means PERCEPTEYE_AGENT_ID, then "openclaw".

capture.description: Set false/0/off to disable local capture entirely. Unset means PERCEPTEYE_CAPTURE, then on.

applyPrompt.description: Set false/0/off to stop applying the control plane's approved system prompt in production mode. Unset means PERCEPTEYE_APPLY_PROMPT, then on.

applyModel.description: Set false/0/off to stop pointing this agent at the control plane's approved model in production mode. Unset means PERCEPTEYE_APPLY_MODEL, then on. Needs hooks.allowConversationAccess=true to take effect at all.

startupObservation.description: Optional exact prompt/tool/provider/model observation available before the first claim. It lets registration carry the same SDK-authored execution fingerprint later reports must match.

executionSnapshot.description: Host-adapter evidence for exact execution identity. Component names are opaque to the SDK; incomplete or invalid evidence emits no identity. A startup observation enables pre-claim registration binding.

mode.description: training: this install claims rollouts and drives turns. production: claims no rollout and starts no turn -- those hooks are never registered -- but captures the turns you serve and applies the system prompt and the model your control plane approved. Unset (or null, or empty) means PERCEPTEYE_AGENT_MODE, then production; a value here overrides the environment. Spellings, in any case: training, train, rollout, rollouts, fine-tuning, finetuning, improving, production, prod, serving. Any other value runs production mode and says so.

introspect.description: Set false/0/off to register this agent with no description at all; the control plane records that as your opt-out. PERCEPTEYE_INTROSPECT=0 refuses too, whatever this says. Unset means on.

describe.description: The agent's own description, for what this plugin cannot observe (OpenClaw's llm_input carries no tools): system_prompt, tools (the list the agent sends its model -- OpenAI function specs, Anthropic tools, or {name, description, input_schema, read_only}) and model (a name, or {model_name, provider, temperature, max_tokens}). What you declare wins where given; it anchors no execution identity. Optionally api_spec: the absolute http(s) URL where the agent's API spec is published, sent as a reference (never the document) and recorded as its Product's spec; it is not part of the description.

retentionTurns.description: Keep only this many most recently written captured turns on disk, pruning the rest every 256 turns, so the directory holds at most retentionTurns + 256. Unset keeps every turn: nothing deletes your capture unless you ask. A whole number, 0 or more.

rules.description: The workflow rules this agent follows, one prose rule per string (a list of strings), registered once per start, with an API key and capture on, as the rulebook of the one Product that declares it -- training guidance, never added to the served agent's prompt. Every start that sets it declares it again, so the last writer wins; [] retracts. Unset sends nothing and leaves the rulebook in force alone.
